author: GinnoB
quote: The game doesn't bring any innovation compared to its previous installments. They built a huge, beautiful world full of life. Unfortunately, the narrative, gameplay, new mechanics, restrictions, and above all the characters and main story make this game one of the most boring experiences I've had in my life. I hope the online multiplayer mode is at least somewhat fun.

author: GinnoB
quote: Back in 1998 Zelda OoT was considered the best game ever made. Now with this renovation it becomes very clear that this is the greatest game in history, it's just perfect.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
